title: Leather care

posts.caption:
Care in four steps.
01 Wipe with a soft dry cloth after wear.
02 Let the pair air dry at room temperature, away from direct heat.
03 Stuff with paper when not worn to keep the shape.
04 Polish or condition the leather now and then.
Save this for later.
